# TRTC Web SDK

`trtc.js` is the unmodified browser UMD build of Tencent's `trtc-sdk-v5` version 5.20.1, including its bundled webrtc-adapter dependency.
The package metadata is retained in `trtc-package.json`.
The SDK is loaded locally only when connecting a Vidu RTC session.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/trtc-sdk-v5/-/trtc-sdk-v5-5.20.1.tgz

Archive integrity (npm SHA-512):
`/bEBFdJKt0I37aXuMSMVs5gPwelm8UWZJmh+YvXwPz2Ny7vdoD3wo6DgCPMRokdt/S97+r5JEnYU3CcM11Mtbg==`

The package declares its license as ISC and contains no standalone license file.
Copyright and notices in the original SDK remain intact.
